source_processing: 1. Raw sequencing data was processed using Cellranger (V3.1) mkfastq to generate fastq files. Fastq files were aligned to hg38 and quantified using CellRanger (V3.1) count applying standard settings. Libraries with poor sequencing quality (as determined by Cellranger metrics: e.g. base quality, percentage of valid barcodes, valid unique molecular identifiers (UMIs) and cluster density) were discarded.
2. Cells were filtered with less than 1000 UMIs, less than 500 covered genes or more than 15% mitochondrial reads.

3. Using Seurat (V4.0.1), data were log normalized to 10,000 counts and subsequently scaled. Considering the uniform treatment of the cohort and uniform processing of samples, batch effect correction was not applied to avoid overcorrection of patient-to-patient differences. The uwot implementation of Uniform Manifold Approximation and Projection (UMAP) (V0.1.1), was used to visualize scRNA-seq data after initialization using principal component analysis (PCA) and calculation of nearest neighbors (nn) by applying the annoy algorithm.

title: PAUZRT_Rem_scRNA
treatment_protocol_ch1: For this study, a cohort of 28 patients who were enrolled in the Children’s Oncology Group (COG) Phase III AAML1031 trial (clinicaltrials.gov, NCT01371981) were studied using single cell sequencing. For the generation of the single cell datasets, patients were selected from Arm B (Standard Chemotherapy (ADE 10+3+5) + Bortezomib (n=24)) or Arm C (Standard Chemotherapy (ADE 10+3) + Sorafenib (n=4)). Four patients that were taken from Arm B were long-term remission patients (no event for at least five years after treatment). None of the patients that were sequenced longitudinally underwent stem cell transplantation.
extract_protocol_ch1: At diagnosis, remission or relapse, bone marrow or blood samples were taken and Ficoll-enrichment was performed followed by viable cryopreservation of the cells (in FBS + DMSO) and long-term storage in liquid nitrogen at the COG biorepository.Cryopreserved samples were taken from liquid nitrogen and thawed in thawing media (50% FBS (ThermoFisher Scientific) + 40% HBSS (Stemcell Technologies) + 100ug/ml DNAseI (Sigma)). Cells were centrifuged (300g for 5 minutes), and washed once with 10ml of ice-cold HBSS + 10% FBS. A second wash with 1ml of HBSS + 10% FBS was performed followed by passing the cell suspension through a 40µm FlowMi filter (SP Bel-Art) into a new 1.5ml Eppendorf tube

Libraries were pooled and converted using the MGIEasy Universal Library Conversion Kit (MGI Americas) following the manufacturer's protocol
